analysis.step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates the workflow of SonarCloud code analysis. First, developers push code to GitHub repositories. This triggers a GitHub webhook event captured by an AWS Lambda function, which creates an analysis request in an SQS queue. An ECS Fargate cluster pulls tasks from the SQS queue, clones the repository code from GitHub, performs analysis, and sends the resulting analysis report to an EC2 instance via an API. The EC2 instance stores the report in an Aurora database. A second ECS Fargate cluster (Compute Engine) polls Aurora for reports, performs code quality metric computations, writes the updated metrics back into Aurora, and writes optimized search data into an Elasticsearch cluster. Finally, developers access the results through a UI/API hosted on EC2.
